exposure: women with SD not seeking care
children under 18 years in the home
outcome: Health care-seeking behavior for sexual dysfunction after birth
finding: While 84.5% of women reported some form of sexual dysfunction after birth, only 16% of those with SD sought care, with factors like perineal healing difficulty, transfusion after birth, and dyspareunia increasing the odds of seeking care, while having children under 18 and multiple cesarean births decreased the odds.
mod_finding: Women who had cesarean births were less likely to seek care for sexual dysfunction after childbirth.
